# Turn-by-Turn Navigation Links

Google Maps strictly limits navigation routes to a maximum of **10 stops** per URL. 

To solve this, I have broken down your 67-stop optimal route into 8 overlapping legs. As you drive, simply click the next link to continue your journey seamlessly. 

> [!TIP]
> The final destination on Leg 8 is **Laganada Printing Press**, which is mathematically the furthest printing shop from your start point in Police Bazaar (approx 5.6km away straight-line distance).
